verdict.rationale: ReadMe documents some fixed event-driven automation. The GitHub AI Writer watches pull requests and proposes doc updates when code changes. Users can also write natural-language Linter rules that run against pages, including during Reviews and Docs Audit. However, these are built-in automations, and there is no evidence that users can author their own event→action rules. Missing for 10: a user-configurable trigger/action rule engine, webhooks or event subscriptions, custom actions beyond linting and PR-based proposals, and independent corroboration.
